climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Mendocino County AVA kept separate from the North Coast AVA because of its own topography, soils and climate. Its boundaries follow the 400 foot contour, which divides the valley floor from higher, forested land.
